text: Professional Overview：The major of Cultural Relics and Museology belongs to the category of history. It mainly studies the basic knowledge and skills in museology, cultural relics studies, etc., and receives skills training in the protection, research, appraisal, and display of cultural heritage. It is engaged in the work of collection preservation, display, protection and restoration in the cultural relics and museums industry.Training Objectives：Cultivate compound talents with the basic theories and knowledge of cultural relics and museology, who can engage in the management and research of cultural relics and museums in government cultural relics management institutions, various museums or exhibition halls, cultural relics and archaeology research institutions, as well as enterprises and institutions or fields such as news publishing and education.Main courses：Core courses: Introduction to Cultural Relics, Introduction to Museology, Museum Practice, Introduction to Major Categories of Cultural Relics, Cultural Relics and Archaeological Techniques, Cultural Relics Protection and Management, General Archaeology, Chinese History, World History.Practical teaching: including social surveys, business internships, annual papers, graduation theses, reading reports, lectures on academic frontiers, and research projects for college students, etc.
